title: OMT protocol envelope (v1)
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 wire envelope for the OMT protocol (KTD2). Single-object messages only (no batch); requests and notifications carry a dot-namespaced method such as "node/create"; every response to an unsupported protocol major carries problem code UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL in error.data.

RequestId.description: Client-chosen correlation id: number or string (null-less).

MethodName.description: Dot-free namespaced method name, e.g. node/create, run/claim, events/resume. The registry of methods and their parity lives in commands.schema.json and parity.schema.json.

JsonRpcRequest.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request expecting a response.

JsonRpcNotification.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 notification (no id, no reply expected). Used by the daemon for server-initiated event push.

JsonRpcError.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error object. code uses the JSON-RPC reserved ranges; the OMT-specific machine-readable problem lives in data as a Problem (R5): assert on data.code/data.details, never on message.

JsonRpcResponse.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response carrying exactly one of result or error.
